people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: If you will walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as your father David walked, then I will lengthen your days.”
translations.bsb: So if you walk in My ways and keep My statutes and commandments, just as your father David did, I will prolong your days.”
translations.kjv: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.
translations.asv: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.
